description: Implementation of the SemWaiter class for semaphore-based thread synchronization in the Abseil library, including methods for waiting with timeout, posting, and internal semaphore handling.

classes.name: SemWaiter
classes.description: A class that manages semaphore-based waiting with support for timeouts and wakeup notifications.

methods.name: SemWaiter::SemWaiter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the semaphore and sets wakeups to zero.

methods.name: SemWaiter::TimedWait
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on the semaphore, using platform-specific functions if available.

methods.name: SemWaiter::Wait
methods.description: Waits for a semaphore signal or timeout, handling wakeups and interruptions.

methods.name: SemWaiter::Post
methods.description: Posts a wakeup signal to the semaphore, potentially waking a waiting thread.

methods.name: SemWaiter::Poke
methods.description: Posts to the semaphore to wake a waiting thread.
